اقتبلتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَبَلَتَا (iqtabalatā) /iq.ta.ba.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# اُقْتُبِلَتَا (uqtubilatā) /uq.tu.bi.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
